result.title: A Hybrid Exact-Heuristic Solver for the Integrated Passenger and Parcel Transportation Problem
result.comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Technical Report for the SOICT 2026 Student Contest
result.summary: We describe the solver we submitted to the second round of the SOICT 2026 contest on the Integrated Passenger and Parcel Transportation problem, a selective pickup-and-delivery routing problem with time windows, open routes and heterogeneous taxis. The solver is a single-file, standard-library Python program that combines (i) a constant-time insertion test based on latest-arrival slack, (ii) greedy insertion, local search and an Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search (ALNS) with simulated-annealing acceptance, and (iii) an exact route-selection engine that enumerates, for every taxi, the best feasible route for each request set and then solves the resulting set-packing problem by branch-and-bound strengthened with route-based large neighborhood search, Lagrangian bounds and reduced-cost fixing. The engine is chosen automatically from the instance size, and an independent verifier and a watchdog guarantee that a valid answer is always printed. On the official evaluation (38 scored instances, 5-minute limit) the solver obtained a total benefit of 487,237, finished every run within 277 s and used at most 279 MB; 28 of the 38 instances terminated well before the limit.

AI.brief_summary: 该文描述 SOICT 2026 竞赛中「乘客与包裹联合运输」问题的求解器，将常数时间插入检验、贪心加 ALNS 局部搜索与基于分支定界、拉格朗日界的精确路径选择引擎结合，并按实例规模自动切换。
